capabilities: provide rich markdown and linked context to agents
extras: The README describes the monorepo package structure rather than how to use the plugin; it notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: AI agent interactions in Obsidian are limited to a single prompt box without rich markdown or linked note context.
summary: Connects your notes to AI agents, giving them rich markdown and linked context instead of a single prompt box, with local and remote terminal sessions.
